title: Wholesome Crispy Slovakian Salt Cod Stir-Fry
description: A kid-friendly Slovakian dish featuring crispy salt cod, stir-fry, and a yeasty flavor profile.
instructions: Prepare the mason-jar bread dough according to the package instructions and set aside to rise.
Heat the sunflower oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion, carrots, and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic powder and caraway seeds to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the salt cod to the skillet and cook until crispy and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the salt cod to a plate and set aside.
Add the mason-jar bread dough to the skillet, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Cook the bread dough for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until crispy and golden brown.
Add the cooked salt cod, lemon juice, and fresh dill to the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve the salt cod stir-fry hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
Serve immediately and enjoy!
Serve 4-6 servings per recipe.
Serve as a hearty lunch or brunch option.
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a green salad for a well-rounded meal.
Serve to a crowd of 4-6 people for a special occasion.
Serve as a comforting and satisfying meal after a long day.
Serve as a unique and flavorful twist on traditional fish and chips.
Serve as a kid-friendly dish that's easy to make and fun to eat.
